Job details mentioned below:  
 

 Title: Software Developer 
 Location: Mclean VA 
 Duration: 3 to 6 Months contract to hire 
 

 Job Description 
 

 Roles and Responsibilities:  
 Monitor processing of thousands of documents each day for success or to troubleshoot 
 Create tools that streamline processing and maintain system stability 
 Collaborate with senior developers to provide strong solutions 
 Translate complex requirements into solutions understood by custom.
 Basic Qualifications:  
 To be considered for this position, you must minimally meet the knowledge, skills, and abilities listed below: 
 Bachelor’s degree and software application development experience.
 web services experience 
 C# development experience combined with 2 or more of the following: JAVA, C, or C++, HTML, XML, or SQL 
 experience within SQL Server 2005 and 2008 
 Upon hire, candidate must have a current or be able to obtain the Comptia Security+ certification. 
 Candidates must be eligible for a Position of Trust Adjudicated by DOD or DISCO
 Preferred Qualifications:  
 Candidates with these desired skills will be given preferential consideration: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other technical degree 
 SQL Server 2008 
 Kofax or OCR software applications 
 EMC Documentum
 
 Bachelor’s degree and software application development experience.
